scope: Manual Paint combo-box tooltips must clear the full outer ComboBox, not only its internal text child.

observations.other_combos: The three combo tips were measured against their outer controls; all intersected that outer rectangle. Width/height controls and bottom action hints did not overlap tested neighboring rows.
observations.manual_paint_row: 15/15 action, role, grid, and zoom hints appeared; none overlapped its button or dimensions label at this geometry.

impact: Visual occlusion of the ComboBox frame only; no project or raster data was changed during the hover test.
next: Use the internal text widget as the tooltip source but the enclosing Motif ComboBox as the collision boundary, then remeasure all three combo hints and run UI hint regressions.
